request.style: English, solemn male solo voice with low choir, harp, cello, flute, timpani, organ, reverent and expectant mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We came from exile to the city gate
With Zerubbabel and the faithful band
Seeking our place in the holy estate
But the records of our names were scant

[Verse]
Sons of Hobaiah and Hakkoz too
And Barzillai who took the Gileadite name
We sought the entry in the book anew
But the trace was lost in history's flame

[Verse]
They searched for our name in the registers
But it could not be found by the eye
Excluded from the priesthood as unclean we stand
Denied the holy service to rely

[Verse]
The governor spoke with a firm decree
Do not eat of the most holy food
Until a priest should arise in the day
To consult the Urim and Thummim in the cloud

[Outro]
We wait for the sign that we are clean
